_comment: Hand-picked corrections where automated selection chose the wrong product. Slug and title matching cannot reliably tell a grocery staple from a lookalike, so these are curated. Merged over the automated picks by basket.py; each records why.

coffee.name: Folgers Classic Roast Ground Coffee 1.23kg
coffee.why: Automation picked Binggrae Coffee Milk, a ready-to-drink beverage. Folgers ground is the closest analogue to the US 12oz ground-coffee basket item, and the same brand exists on both sides, which makes the cross-country comparison honest.

chicken.name: Bounty Chicken Breast approx 1.4kg
chicken.why: Automation picked frozen Ajinomoto Chicken Karaage, a prepared product. This is raw chicken breast sold by weight, matching the PRD basket item.

coffee.name: Nescafe Classic Tipid Pack 50g
coffee.why: Automation picked Nescafe Original 200g at PHP 949.95, which works out to PHP 4,750/kg - roughly 4.5x every other instant coffee in the same catalogue, so it is almost certainly a case or a mispriced line. The Tipid Pack is the standard instant refill and the representative PH form named in items.json.

not_available._comment: Items a store genuinely does not stock, confirmed by hand. Recorded so nobody re-investigates, and so the index knows the gap is real rather than a scraper fault.

ph-shopgaisano.chicken: Searched its Shopify catalogue for chicken and whole chicken: only spreads, bouillon cubes, canned Progresso soup and dog treats. No raw or fresh chicken is sold online.
